description: PHASE 2 SLICE 2 — Block / Mute / Report safety actions. Introduce a SafetyRepository (ChangeNotifier singleton, X.instance, MockData-fallback + guarded Supabase persistence) that owns the viewer's block set, mute set (client-side mute is a product differentiator not present server-side), and report submissions. Blocks persist to the FEAT-002 `public.blocks` join table keyed by (blocker, blocked) mirroring the likes/reposts persistence pattern; the server RLS + can_view_profile already enforce mutual-block invisibility, so the client persists the block row and applies an OPTIMISTIC client-side filter so blocked/muted authors disappear from the feed immediately (server reconciles on next load). Mute is client-authoritative (no server table this phase) and hides an author's posts locally. Report submits to a NEW migration 0004 `public.reports` table (client-insert of own reports; no read exposure of others' reports) with a guarded fire-and-forget insert; the UI shows an optimistic 'reported' confirmation. Block/Mute/Report actions are surfaced from profiles (profile_screen overflow menu) and posts (post_card overflow menu). PostRepository feed getters (forYou/following) filter out posts whose author is blocked or muted. All new pure logic (filtering, block/mute set semantics, report validation) is unit-tested on the mock path.
steps: Migration: create supabase/migrations/0004_reports.sql (DO NOT edit 0001/0002/0003). Follow 0002's exact SQL style (lowercase kw, create table if not exists, drop policy if exists before create policy, security-definer conventions where relevant, idempotent/re-runnable, header comment block noting apply-after-0002). Table public.reports (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), reporter uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, target_type text not null check (target_type in ('post','profile','comment')), target_id uuid not null, reason text not null check (char_length(reason) between 1 and 500), created_at timestamptz default now()). Enable RLS. Policies: insert own (reporter = auth.uid()); select own (reporter = auth.uid()) — reporters may see their own submissions but NOT others'; NO update/delete policy for authenticated (reports are append-only from the client; moderation tooling is a later privileged concern). Add index reports(reporter, created_at desc) and reports(target_type, target_id). Add a header comment: reports are client-authored, read-restricted to their author, and moderation review/resolution is deferred to a later phase (env risk: live application unverified here). NOTE the intentional client-side mute model (no server table this phase) in a comment.

Repository: create lib/data/safety_repository.dart — a ChangeNotifier singleton `SafetyRepository.instance` seeded from MockData (add MockData.blockedUserIds()/mutedUserIds() returning empty or a tiny seed set, and MockData.muteWords() empty seed) with: synchronous getters `Set<String> get blockedIds`, `Set<String> get mutedIds` (unmodifiable views); `bool isBlocked(String userId)`, `bool isMuted(String userId)`; mutators `void block(String userId)`, `void unblock(String userId)`, `void mute(String userId)`, `void unmute(String userId)` each optimistic + single notify + idempotent (no notify when already in the desired state) with guarded fire-and-forget persistence for blocks (insert/delete on public.blocks keyed by blocker=auth.uid(),blocked=userId, mirroring PostRepository._persistLike) — mute is in-memory only this phase (documented); and `Future<void> report({required String targetType, required String targetId, required String reason})` that validates reason (non-empty, <=500 to mirror the check constraint, throwing a ReportValidationError like CommentValidationError) then guarded-inserts into public.reports. Add a guarded `load()` hydrating blockedIds from public.blocks for the signed-in user (fire-and-forget from constructor, mock fallback). Document the client-side mute rationale and the server-owns-block-enforcement (can_view_profile) note.

Feed filtering: in lib/data/post_repository.dart, filter forYou()/following() to exclude posts whose author.id is in SafetyRepository.instance.blockedIds or mutedIds, applied AFTER ranking so ordering is unchanged for visible posts. Keep the unmodifiable-view + synchronous + single-notify contract intact and DO NOT break existing post_repository_test.dart (which constructs a fresh PostRepository; ensure the default SafetyRepository has an empty block/mute set so existing feed assertions are unaffected — if the singleton could leak state into tests, gate the filter so an empty safety set is a pure pass-through). Prefer injecting the filter via a small pure helper (e.g. a top-level or static `List<Post> filterHidden(List<Post> posts, {required Set<String> blocked, required Set<String> muted})`) that is independently unit-testable and defaults to identity on empty sets.

UI — posts: add an overflow (three-dot) menu to lib/widgets/post_card.dart (or its header) with actions Mute author, Block author, Report post. Wire them to SafetyRepository (mute/block) and to a report bottom-sheet/dialog collecting a reason (Report). Show optimistic snackbars ('Muted', 'Blocked', 'Reported'). Provide Undo for mute/block where trivial. Ensure the menu does not disrupt existing PostCard callbacks (onLike/onRepost/onBookmark) or its existing layout/tests.

UI — profiles: add an overflow menu to lib/screens/profile_screen.dart SliverAppBar actions (only when NOT the current user) with Block / Mute / Report profile, wired to SafetyRepository; when a profile is blocked, reflect it (e.g. a 'Blocked' state on the follow button / a lightweight blocked banner). Add a management surface reachable from SettingsScreen (FEAT-005) listing blocked + muted accounts with unblock/unmute affordances (resolve ids to profiles via ProfileRepository.profiles; show empty-state when none).

Report validation + confirmation: define ReportValidationError (mirroring CommentValidationError) and surface validation feedback in the report UI. On successful submit show a confirmation; guarded persistence means offline still confirms optimistically (documented).

Tests: add test/safety_repository_test.dart (pure, no Supabase): block/unblock and mute/unmute flip the sets, notify exactly once on change, and are idempotent (no notify when unchanged); isBlocked/isMuted reflect state; report() throws ReportValidationError on empty/over-500 reason and does not throw on valid input in the mock path; the pure filterHidden helper removes blocked+muted authors, is identity on empty sets, and preserves order. Add/extend test/post_repository_test.dart ONLY if needed to assert feed filtering with an injected/known safety set WITHOUT weakening existing assertions (prefer testing the pure filter helper directly so the existing repo tests stay unchanged).
Run verification; ensure no NEW analyzer issues and all tests green; discard the tooling exclude block in analysis_options.yaml before finishing.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/0004_reports.sql exists (0001/0002/0003 byte-for-byte unchanged), is idempotent, defines public.reports with insert-own + select-own RLS and no update/delete policy, the listed check constraints, and the two indexes

lib/data/safety_repository.dart provides a ChangeNotifier singleton with block/unblock/mute/unmute (optimistic, single-notify, idempotent, guarded block persistence to public.blocks) and a validated, guarded report() inserting into public.reports; blocks hydrate via a guarded load()
PostRepository feeds hide posts from blocked/muted authors via a pure, independently-tested filter that is identity on empty sets; existing post_repository_test.dart passes unchanged

Block/Mute/Report actions are reachable from both post_card and profile_screen; a blocked/muted management list is reachable from Settings; report collects a reason with validation and shows confirmation
New unit tests (test/safety_repository_test.dart + pure filter tests) pass; ReportValidationError enforces the 1..500 reason bound
`flutter analyze` reports only the 8 baseline INFO lints (no NEW issues) and `flutter test` passes
verification: export HOME=/tmp/fakehome PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH" PUB_CACHE=/opt/pub-cache && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test

git diff --stat feat/phase1-data-backend-hardening -- supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql supabase/migrations/0002_authz_and_core_tables.sql supabase/migrations/0003_follow_accept_notification.sql shows no changes to those files
Structural review of 0004_reports.sql: idempotency guards, RLS insert-own + select-own only, check constraints, indexes; confirm no service_role/secret key present
findings: Implemented Phase 2 Slice 2 (block/mute/report safety actions) fully in Dart + one SQL migration + tests. Committed as 1a8019c on feat/phase2-privacy-safety-identity. CHANGES: (1) supabase/migrations/0004_reports.sql — new public.reports table (id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), reporter uuid refs auth.users on delete cascade, target_type text check in ('post','profile','comment'), target_id uuid not null, reason text check char_length between 1 and 500, created_at timestamptz default now()), RLS enabled with reports_insert_own (auth.uid()=reporter) + reports_select_own (auth.uid()=reporter) and NO update/delete policy (append-only; moderation deferred). Indexes idx_reports_reporter_created (reporter, created_at desc) and idx_reports_target (target_type, target_id). Idempotent (create table if not exists, drop policy if exists before create policy, create index if not exists). Header comment notes apply-after-0002, the client-side mute model (no server table this phase), and the env-risk (live application unverified). No service_role/secret key present. 0001/0002/0003 byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff empty). (2) lib/data/safety_repository.dart — SafetyRepository ChangeNotifier singleton .instance seeded from new MockData.blockedUserIds()/mutedUserIds()/muteWords() (all EMPTY seeds). Synchronous getters blockedIds/mutedIds (unmodifiable views), isBlocked/isMuted; mutators block/unblock/mute/unmute each optimistic + single-notify + idempotent (no notify when already in desired state). Blocks persist to public.blocks keyed (blocker=auth.uid(), blocked=userId) via guarded fire-and-forget _persistBlock insert/delete mirroring PostRepository._persistLike; mute is in-memory only (documented). report({targetType,targetId,reason}) validates reason (non-empty trimmed, <=500) throwing ReportValidationError (mirrors CommentValidationError) then guarded-inserts into public.reports. Guarded load() hydrates blockedIds from public.blocks for the signed-in user (fire-and-forget from ctor, mock fallback, only notifies on real change via setEquals). Documented client-side mute rationale + server-owns-enforcement (can_view_profile). Top-level PURE helper filterHidden(posts,{blocked,muted}) is IDENTITY (returns the same instance) on empty sets and preserves order. (3) lib/data/post_repository.dart — forYou()/following() now pass ranked lists through a private _visible() that delegates to filterHidden over SafetyRepository.instance sets, applied AFTER ranking. Identity on empty sets so existing post_repository_test.dart is unaffected. (4) lib/widgets/post_card.dart — replaced the dead more_horiz InkWell with a PopupMenuButton (_PostOverflowMenu): Mute @user / Block @user (optimistic + Undo snackbar) / Report post (opens report sheet). Existing onLike/onRepost/onBookmark callbacks + layout untouched. (5) lib/widgets/report_sheet.dart — new showReportSheet() modal collecting a reason (maxLength=500), surfacing ReportValidationError inline, and showing an optimistic 'Reported' snackbar on submit. (6) lib/screens/profile_screen.dart — SliverAppBar shows a PopupMenuButton (Mute/Unmute, Block/Unblock, Report) only when NOT the current user; build now listens to Listenable.merge([PostRepository, SafetyRepository]); blocked state reflected via 'Blocked' follow-button label + a blocked banner. (7) lib/screens/blocked_muted_screen.dart — new management surface (SafetyListKind.blocked|muted) listing ids resolved to profiles via ProfileRepository.profiles with per-row Unblock/Unmute and an empty-state; reachable from Settings. (8) lib/screens/settings_screen.dart — the two Privacy & Safety entries now navigate to BlockedMutedScreen (removed the coming-soon stub). (9) test/safety_repository_test.dart — 15 tests: empty seeds, unmodifiable views, block/unblock + mute/unmute flip/notify-once/idempotent, isBlocked/isMuted, report() throws on empty/over-500 and completes on valid (incl. exactly-500), and filterHidden identity-on-empty + blocked/muted/union removal preserving order. VERIFICATION: flutter pub get OK; flutter analyze = only the 8 pre-existing baseline INFO lints, NO new issues, exit 0; flutter test = 90/90 pass (75 baseline + 15 new); existing post_repository_test.dart and profile_repository_test.dart pass unchanged. analysis_options.yaml tooling-appended exclude block discarded (git checkout) and NOT committed. git diff confirms 0001/0002/0003 unchanged. ENV RISKS / UNVERIFIED-LIVE-SUPABASE CAVEAT: no reachable/administerable Supabase project and no service-role key here, so 0004_reports.sql was validated by STRUCTURAL REVIEW ONLY — its live application and the true RLS behavior (insert-own/select-own on reports, and the server-side block enforcement via can_view_profile that makes blocked authors' profiles/posts invisible on next load) are UNVERIFIED in this build. The client applies an OPTIMISTIC local filter for immediate block/mute feedback; the server reconciles on next PostRepository.load(). Mute is intentionally client-only (no server table). Guarded persistence (_persistBlock/_persistReport/load) no-ops cleanly offline/unauthenticated and never throws into the UI/tests, so offline report submits still confirm optimistically. No Android SDK/emulator so no apk/device/widget-golden verification; report sheet + overflow menus + management screen were verified by analyze + compile + unit tests on the pure logic only, not by widget/device runs. === V1 REVIEW FIXES (2026-09-08-121218-review.md, NEEDS_CHANGES) === Addressed the two review issues touching this slice: (Issue 1, BLOCKING — self-directed safety actions) lib/widgets/post_card.dart now guards the overflow menu exactly like profile_screen.dart: the build computes isOwnPost = author.id == ProfileRepository.instance.currentUser.id and passes const SizedBox.shrink() instead of _PostOverflowMenu on own-authored posts, so Mute/Block/Report are no longer reachable on the viewer's own posts (added the profile_repository import). (Issue 4 + defense-in-depth for Issue 1 — feed filter own-post edge) the pure filterHidden helper in lib/data/safety_repository.dart gained an optional String? viewerId param; when set, a post authored by viewerId is ALWAYS exempt (never dropped by a self-block/self-mute/self-muted-word). PostRepository._visible() now passes viewerId: ProfileRepository.instance.currentUser.id, so the author's own posts can never vanish from forYou()/following() (and therefore never drop out of exportMyData(), which sources posts from forYou()). filterHidden REMAINS IDENTITY (same instance) on all-empty sets — the invariant is untouched — and viewerId is null-safe/optional so every existing call site and test is unchanged. Added tests: test/safety_repository_test.dart asserts a self-blocked/self-muted own post stays visible AND that the exemption is scoped (other blocked authors still filtered); test/mute_words_test.dart asserts a self-authored post matching a muted word is not hidden when viewerId matches. All prior filterHidden identity-on-empty tests kept UNCHANGED. VERIFICATION after fixes: flutter analyze = still exactly the 8 baseline INFO lints (no new issues), flutter test = 122/122 pass (118 baseline + 4 added), analysis_options.yaml exclude block discarded (not committed). (Issue 5 — reports de-dupe/rate-limit) DEFERRED by design: report() stays append-only; client-side de-dupe/rate-limiting is intentionally left to the later privileged moderation phase (server-side), and adding a client throttle would be defeated by a reinstall and is out of scope for this slice. Documented as informational, not fixed.
